name: Bryan Shuster
occupation: Worked in the family business, Ideal Foods
prior_offices: Laramie City Council (20 years, per his 2022 statement)
background: Bryan Shuster ran as a Republican for House District 14 in 2022. In his 2022 voter-guide statement he pointed to 20 years on the Laramie City Council, including work on biennial budgets and monthly finance meetings, and service connected with the Wyoming Territorial Park Board, Planning Commission, Airport Board, Laramie Railroad Depot Board, and Rifle Range Board. He wrote that this public-service background came alongside work in the family business, Ideal Foods, which he said gave him a view of how businesses are affected by government.
